strings.ui.c4.numbers.title: The number chain
strings.ui.c4.numbers.subtitle: One wagon on the transfer siding, four numbers under one coat of paint
strings.ui.c4.numbers.instruction: On each points post, hang the plate the wagon bore there. Under each coat of paint is the number before it – hold the plates up to the lamp.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.wrong: Test run stopped at {post}: under “{piece}” it says “{under}” – not “{prev}”.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.wrong_first: Test run stopped at W 1: under “{piece}” there is still an older number.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.incomplete: First a plate on every points post.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.hint: Hold each plate up to the lamp: under the paint is the number before. Start with the plate that has only bare metal beneath – and compare the dates in the points book.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.success: One wagon, four numbers. In January it ran to Veltrava as C-17/42; after that it stood in our books as 47 702, “under repair”. On Tuesday it runs as C-17/45.
strings.ui.c4.routes.title: Route 74
strings.ui.c4.routes.subtitle: Marta’s tracing paper over the Süd 8 site plan
strings.ui.c4.routes.instruction: Lay the Route 74 diversions on the site plan so that each loop goes round a shaft. Arrow keys move, R rotates.
strings.ui.c4.routes.wrong: The loops lie beside the shafts.
strings.ui.c4.routes.wrong_turned: Marta draws in the direction of travel – this way round, no loop fits.
strings.ui.c4.routes.hint: Marta draws in the direction of travel, not to north. Turn the tracing paper once and find a shaft for each diversion.
strings.ui.c4.routes.success: Three diversions, three shafts. Every loop of Route 74 goes round a house beneath which the annex draws breath. They cleared the houses where I drew in the shafts.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.state_full: All four posts filled – test run?
strings.ui.c4.numbers.state_held: “{face}” in hand – click a points post
strings.ui.c4.numbers.tip_mouse: Click a plate, then a points post – or drag it there. Clicking a hanging plate takes it down again.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.tip_pad: D-pad ←/→ picks a plate, A hangs it, B takes the last one down, X lamp, Y test run.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.wrong_bare: Test run stopped at {post}: under “{piece}” is bare metal – that number was the first, not the one after “{prev}”.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.wrong_generic: Test run stopped: the numbers don’t fit together.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.error: The test run isn’t possible right now: {error}
strings.ui.c4.numbers.controls: Keys 1–4 hang a plate on the next free points post, Backspace takes the last one down, R rearranges, L holds the plates up to the lamp, Enter starts the test run.
strings.ui.c4.numbers.post_tip_filled: {post}: “{face}” – click or right-click takes it down
strings.ui.c4.numbers.plate_tip: “{face}” – click it, then a points post
strings.ui.c4.routes.tip_mouse: Drag the tracing paper with the mouse. Mouse wheel or right-click rotates it.
strings.ui.c4.routes.tip_pad: D-pad moves, RB/LB rotate, A compares, X puts the paper back, Y undoes the last move.
strings.ui.c4.routes.plan.title: Site plan Süd 8
strings.ui.c4.routes.controls: Arrow keys or WASD move the tracing paper one square, R rotates it (Shift+R back), Backspace undoes the last move, Enter compares.
strings.ui.c4.routes.board_tip: Drag tracing paper · mouse wheel or right-click rotates
strings.ui.memories.place.L_C4_TunnelsB: Transfer siding beneath the goods yard, Karsk
strings.ui.memories.decided.name_marta: This is where I gave Marta Vogel’s name – for the Lindner file.
strings.ui.memories.decided.protect_marta: This is where I gave no name. The file stayed in the cabinet.
strings.ui.memories.echo.c4b_solve_routes: Three diversions, three shafts. Marta’s route had recorded the clearances before I understood them.
strings.ui.memories.echo.c4c_solve_numbers: One wagon, four numbers. Under each coat of paint, the one before. On Tuesday it runs again.
